rounds.text: Career Point Edutech Ltd trades at an attractive P/E of 16x alongside an EV/EBITDA of 12.06x, which stands well below the sector benchmark of 14.06x [E1, E11]. The business demonstrates exceptional capital efficiency, posting a return on capital employed of 40.87% to 46.7% and a multi-year median return on equity of 41%, significantly outperforming the broader sector benchmarks [E8, E10, E12, E13, E18]. Fundamentals continue to strengthen through operational excellence, evidenced by operating margins expanding by 16 percentage points over three years to reach 51%, and a robust cash position supported by zero debt and solid free cash flows of ₹ 19 Cr [E21, E27, E29, E48]. Institutional participation is on the rise as domestic institutions increased their holdings to 2.53% from zero over the year, contributing to a positive money flow signal [E34, E35]. Furthermore, a reverse DCF model reveals that the current market price of ₹ 197 merely prices in a modest 5.4% earnings growth rate, leaving a massive valuation gap compared to the intrinsic value calculated at ₹ 493 per share [E2, E36, E38]. Conceded: trailing twelve-month sales growth has slowed to 3% and the stock trades below its 200-day moving average [E15, E56].
